label: <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Fires only on the delimiter step (input <DEL>, t == L), never in the original or copy phases. Within the delimiter step it depends on sequence length: zero for L<=5, rare at L=6-7 (3% of mass), 6% of delimiter steps at L=8 and 49% at L=9 (70% of mass). Activations are larger for L=9 than L=8. Among long sequences, which ones fire depends diffusely on token content: higher rates when the first original token is z/k/o/e, the second is k/2/h/z, or the sequence has more digits. No compact token rule was found, so precision stays around 0.36 while recall of activation mass is about 0.97.
